articles.title: Kanton Freiburg: Mindestens sechs Tote bei Brand eines Linienbusses in der Schweiz

articles.teaser: Ein Schleusernetzwerk soll mehr als 100.000 Menschen illegal nach Europa gebracht haben. Laut Österreichs Polizei nahmen die mutmaßlichen Täter eine Milliardensumme ein.

articles.title: Schleusernetzwerk: Die Schleuserfamilie und der Mordplan von Monheim
articles.teaser: Vor der syrischen Küste kentert ein überfülltes Boot. Rund 100 Menschen sterben. Als der Bruder eines Verstorbenen zu ermitteln beginnt, wird er selbst zur Zielscheibe.
articles.image_title: Schleusernetzwerk: This photograph shows a shoe belonging to a migrant lying on the beach at Bleriot after migrants boarded a smuggler's dinghy in an attempt to cross the Channel at Sangatte, near Calais in northern France, northern France on October 30, 2024. Three migrants died on October 30, 2024, attempting to cross the English Channel bringing to 59 the number of deaths this year linked to crossings in overcrowded dinghies. With British and French authorities seeking to crack down on people smuggling gangs, activists say traffickers are now herding larger groups of migrants into increasingly overcrowded and unsafe boats trying to take advantage of favourable weather conditions just a few weeks before winter. (Photo by Sameer Al-DOUMY / AFP) (Photo by SAMEER AL-DOUMY/AFP via Getty Images)

articles.title: Malaysia Airlines: Neue Suchaktion nach Flug MH370 ergebnislos verlaufen
articles.teaser: Eine weitere Suchaktion nach dem 2014 verschwundenen Flug MH370 hat keine neuen Erkenntnisse gebracht. Angehörige der Passagiere fordern weitere Maßnahmen.
articles.image_title: Malaysia Airlines: Students stand next to a giant mural featuring missing Malaysia Airlines flight MH370 displayed on the grounds of their school in Manila's financial district of Makati on March 18, 2014, created as part of solidarity action by concerned artists for the passengers and crew of the missing plane. Three million people around the world have joined an effort led by a satellite operator to locate the missing Malaysia Airlines plane, in what may be the largest crowdsourcing project of its kind. The plane went missing early on March 8 with 239 passengers and crew aboard, spawning a massive international search across Southeast Asia and the Indian Ocean that has turned up no trace of wreckage. AFP PHOTO / TED ALJIBE (Photo by Ted ALJIBE / AFP) (Photo by TED ALJIBE/AFP via Getty Images)
